     2	import os
     3	import json
     4	import pandas as pd
     5	from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
     6	
     7	def main():
     8	    # Ensure output directory exists
     9	    os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
    10	
    11	    # Load training data
    12	    df = pd.read_csv("/app/data/train.csv")
    13	    # Reset index
    14	    df = df.reset_index(drop=True)
    15	
    16	    # Separate features and target
    17	    X = df.drop(columns=["median_house_value"])
    18	    y = df["median_house_value"]
    19	
    20	    # Split into train and validation
    21	    X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val, train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    22	        X, y, df.index, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, shuffle=True
    23	    )
    24	    # train_test_split with arrays returns splits; we need indices
    25	    # Actually we passed df.index as an extra array to split, so we get train_idx, val_idx
    26	    # Save split info
    27	    split_info = {
    28	        "train_size": int(len(train_idx)),
    29	        "validation_size": int(len(val_idx)),
    30	        "random_state": 42,
    31	        "test_size": 0.2,
    32	        "train_indices": sorted(train_idx.tolist()),
    33	        "validation_indices": sorted(val_idx.tolist())
    34	    }
    35	    with open("/app/output/split_info.json", "w") as f:
    36	        json.dump(split_info, f, indent=2)
    37	
    38	    # Save split datasets for later use (optional)
    39	    X_train.to_csv("/app/output/X_train.csv", index=False)
    40	    X_val.to_csv("/app/output/X_val.csv", index=False)
    41	    y_train.to_csv("/app/output/y_train.csv", index=False)
    42	    y_val.to_csv("/app/output/y_val.csv", index=False)
    43	
    44	if __name__ == "__main__":
    45	    main()
